definitions.explanation: Of great significance or consequence, often with serious implications.

examples.japanese: {重大|じゅうだい}な{発表|はっぴょう}があります。
{重大|じゅうだい}な{ミス|みす}を{犯|おか}してしまいました。
この{問題|もんだい}は{重大|じゅうだい}です。

notes:
{重大|じゅうだい} is a na-adjective meaning serious or important.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: Not commonly used adverbially
- Noun modifier: {重大|じゅうだい}な + noun
- Noun form: {重大|じゅうだい}さ (seriousness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {重大|じゅうだい}な{決定|けってい} (important decision)
- {重大|じゅうだい}な{事故|じこ} (serious accident)
- {重大|じゅうだい}な{責任|せきにん} (serious responsibility)
- {重大|じゅうだい}{発表|はっぴょう} (important announcement)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {重要|じゅうよう}: important (significance)
- {重大|じゅうだい}: serious/grave (consequences)
- {深刻|しんこく}: serious (problems, situations)
